summary:
The situation around the Strait of Hormuz remains uncertain
On June 17, the US and Iran signed a 14-point memorandum of understanding (the "Islamabad Memorandum" or MoU). This set up a 60-day extension of the ceasefire, specifically intended for drafting a permanent treaty. The agreement committed both nations to an immediate and permanent cessation of military operations on all fronts.
